room.title: Best TRV: new room
room.description: One entry controls one room. Pick the physical TRV(s), the real room-temperature sensor, and the sensor that tells you the heat pump loop is currently cooling.

data_description.suspend_sensor_entity_id: Any entity - a portable/split AC unit, a window/door sensor, anything with a state that means something else is already conditioning this room. Leave empty to not use this.
data_description.suspend_active_value: The state value(s) above that mean Best TRV should turn this room's TRV(s) off rather than fight whatever else is active. Comma-separated if there's more than one (e.g. a climate entity's own heat,cool,heat_cool,dry modes).

trv_mapping.title: Link each TRV's auxiliary entities
trv_mapping.description: For each of the {trv_count} selected TRV(s), pick the number entity Zigbee2MQTT created for its external_temperature_input, and the select entity for its sensor source. Suggested defaults are pre-filled where a matching entity was found.

template.title: Best TRV: new schedule template
template.description: A named, shareable weekly schedule - no TRVs involved. Edit its actual time/temperature slots later, with the same dashboard card used for a room's own schedule, pointed at this template's entity. Point one or more rooms at it via Configure → Schedule source.

data_description.template_parent_entry_id: Inherit whatever days this template doesn't itself override from another template. Choose "-" for a root template with no parent.

data.min_delta: Minimum change before re-sending the feed temperature (°C)
data.forced_refresh_seconds: Force a refresh at least every (seconds)

data_description.suspend_sensor_entity_id: Any entity - a portable/split AC unit, a window/door sensor, anything with a state that means something else is already conditioning this room. Leave empty to not use this.
data_description.suspend_active_value: The state value(s) above that mean Best TRV should turn this room's TRV(s) off rather than fight whatever else is active. Comma-separated if there's more than one (e.g. a climate entity's own heat,cool,heat_cool,dry modes).

schedule_toggle.title: Best TRV: schedule on/off
schedule_toggle.description: When on, the schedule sets the target temperature automatically at each configured time. Adjusting the temperature by hand between two scheduled times is not overwritten until the next scheduled change.

schedule_source.title: Best TRV: schedule source
schedule_source.description: Keep this room's own schedule (edited on its own card), or follow a shared template instead - editing the template then changes every room that follows it. A room following a template can't also locally override a day; switch back to "own" first if you need that.

data_description.schedule_template_entry_id: Only used when schedule source is "template" above. Choose "-" if you haven't created a template yet - this room simply won't auto-schedule until you do.

data_description.template_parent_entry_id: Inherit whatever days this template doesn't itself override from another template. Choose "-" for a root template with no parent.

error.template_parent_cycle: That would make this template its own ancestor - choose a different parent.

resync_schedule.name: Resync schedule
resync_schedule.description: Immediately re-apply whatever the weekly schedule currently says for this entity, discarding any manual temperature override without waiting for the next scheduled transition.

set_schedule_day.name: Set schedule day
set_schedule_day.description: Replace one weekday's schedule slots. Used by the Best TRV schedule card - replaces the whole day in one call rather than editing a single slot in place.

slots.name: Slots
slots.description: The day's full new list of {time, temperature} slots.

set_schedule_days.name: Set schedule days
set_schedule_days.description: Apply the same schedule slots to several weekdays at once, in a single atomic write. Used by the Best TRV schedule card's "push to other days" action.

slots.name: Slots
slots.description: The full new list of {time, temperature} slots to apply to every selected day.

set_schedule_enabled.name: Set schedule enabled
set_schedule_enabled.description: Turn the weekly schedule on or off.

enabled.name: Enabled
enabled.description: Whether the schedule should be active.

set_template_day.name: Set template day
set_template_day.description: Replace one weekday's schedule slots on a schedule template. Used by the Best TRV schedule card when pointed at a template entity - see set_schedule_day for the equivalent on a room.

slots.name: Slots
slots.description: The day's full new list of {time, temperature} slots.

set_template_days.name: Set template days
set_template_days.description: Apply the same schedule slots to several weekdays on a schedule template at once, in a single atomic write. Used by the Best TRV schedule card's "push to other days" action on a template entity.

slots.name: Slots
slots.description: The full new list of {time, temperature} slots to apply to every selected day.
